contract.acceptance: Actual functions/index.js deployed wrapper rejects wildcard origin grant, ignores hostile Host and sanitizes unknown-agent exceptions; six runtime holdouts and five original health/key/trace anchors. Retain all231source-unit assertions and source Rust/TS architecture. No merge before full CI/type/build/security and real Ruflo/Darwin/Flywheel gates.
contract.scope: Actual installed Functions Framework loopback HTTP and real deployment wrapper; no router/fetch/crypto mocks. Synthetic header is not a provider credential; unknown agent fails before any LLM or persistence invocation.
contract.rollback: Forward revert regenerated two runtime JS files and npm test wiring; preserve append-only evidence.

boundary: regressed=true is the explicit full-gate veto for existing type/build/audit failures and unavailable RuOS/Ruflo/offline learning, not newly observed component regression. cost/noop0 neutral/unmeasured; root-only replay is not candidate promotion proof.
